# InnerLamp

Native Android app, currently in its initial scaffold state (single-module, default Android
Studio "Empty Activity" Compose template — `MainActivity` just renders a "Hello Android" greeting).
There is no custom architecture (no ViewModel/data/network layers) yet, so don't assume MVVM,
DI, or navigation are already set up — check current source before referencing patterns that
may not exist.

## Stack
- Kotlin 2.2.10, AGP 9.4.0, Jetpack Compose (BOM `2026.02.01`), Material3.
- `namespace`/`applicationId`: `com.example.innerlamp`. `minSdk = 29`, `targetSdk`/`compileSdk = 37`.
- Single Gradle module: `:app`. Version catalog lives in `gradle/libs.versions.toml` — add new
  dependencies there (`[libraries]`/`[versions]`) rather than hardcoding coordinates in
  `app/build.gradle.kts`.

## Build, test, lint
Always use the wrapper (`./gradlew`, or `gradlew.bat` on Windows), not a global `gradle`.

- Build debug APK: `./gradlew assembleDebug`
- Full unit test suite (JVM, `app/src/test`): `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest`
- Single unit test class: `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest --tests "com.example.innerlamp.ExampleUnitTest"`
- Single unit test method: `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest --tests "com.example.innerlamp.ExampleUnitTest.addition_isCorrect"`
- Instrumented/UI tests (`app/src/androidTest`, needs an emulator/device): `./gradlew connectedDebugAndroidTest`
- Lint: `./gradlew lint` (report at `app/build/reports/lint-results-debug.html`)

## Code layout
- `app/src/main/java/com/example/innerlamp/` — app code; `MainActivity.kt` is the entry point.
- `app/src/main/java/com/example/innerlamp/ui/theme/` — Compose theming (`Color.kt`, `Theme.kt`,
  `Type.kt`, generated by the template). Wrap new screens in `InnerLampTheme { ... }`.
- `app/src/test/` — local JUnit4 unit tests. `app/src/androidTest/` — instrumented tests using
  `androidx.test`/Espresso/Compose UI test.
- `app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml` — single `MainActivity` declared as launcher activity.

## Conventions
- Composables are top-level `@Composable fun` with a trailing `modifier: Modifier = Modifier`
  parameter, matching `Greeting(name, modifier)` in `MainActivity.kt`.
- Previews use `@Preview(showBackground = true)` wrapping content in `InnerLampTheme`.
- Package name stays `com.example.innerlamp` throughout (matches `namespace`/`applicationId`);
  keep new files under this package unless intentionally restructuring.
